item.summary: The 21st Maritime State Development Council (MSDC) concluded today in Mumbai with landmark outcomes for India’s maritime sector. This was the first meeting of the MSDC after its recognition as a statutory consultative body under the Indian Ports Act, 2025, notified on 15th May 2026. item.title: 21st Meeting of Maritime State Development Council Concludes Successfully at Mumbai
